power.frequency: 50 Hz (east, incl. Tokyo) / 60 Hz (west, incl. Osaka)
power.notes: Most phone, laptop, and camera chargers accept 100-240 V — check the 'INPUT' label; if it says 100-240V you only need a plug adapter. Hair dryers and straighteners often don't: run low-heat at 100 V or leave them home.
